rationale: Pulp-owned JS runtime changes under the watched design-import families: the materialized metadata applier reads layout metrics in phases ahead of its writes (78 to 2 layout passes on one apply, byte-identical renders), @pulp/react resolves typography length units before the bridge, installs one native listener per widget event, and type-checks a consumer against its published declarations (the generator now omits DOM-lib names from the global block). Generated bridge outputs change only their fingerprint and two global declarations. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: cd packages/pulp-react && npm run build && npx vitest run
ctest --test-dir build -R 'geometry reads batched ahead of writes cost one layout pass'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'letter spacing given an em string is read as bare pixels'
